descriptions: Animation Sync (Multiplayer): Pet animations are now broadcast to nearby players in real time.
Server-Side Rate Limiting: Added cooldowns on feed, drink, fetch, sleep, purchases, revive and bury events.
Pet Name Validation: Names are sanitized on client and server — control chars stripped, 2-50 char limit enforced.
Auto-Save System: Pet stats are automatically saved to the database every 5 minutes.
ActivePets Stability Fix: Switching pets no longer overwrites unsaved stats from the previous pet.
